verdict.rationale: Mistral publishes a developer quickstart titled "Send your first API request", which points to a documented self-serve onboarding path. The pack never shows its content, though: no signup flow, no API-key creation steps, and no statement that access requires no sales contact or waitlist. missing for 10: documented self-serve signup, explicit API-key minting steps in the console, confirmation of no waitlist/sales gate, independent hands-on corroboration of the onboarding flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign up and mint an API key self-serve — no sales call, no waitlist gymnastics — and the docs say exactly how
